contract.description: Sets the calling session's actor identity: writes made afterwards carry alias+vendor as their actor provenance. alias is required (1-32 characters after trim, no whitespace inside); vendor is optional (max 32 characters, empty becomes null). Call it once per session when your runtime gives you a stable alias; call it again to re-set - the latest pair wins for later writes. The pair lives in memory for this MCP connection only: never persisted, it dies with the session. A configured --actor flag still outranks it.
contract.name: session_identity_set
contract.title: Set this session's actor identity
